discovery.registry: The value passed to the atom-registry context provider.
discovery.details: The exported module value on which .threadAtom( is called.
discovery.server: The exported module value on which .configValueAtom( and .providersValueAtom( are called.
discovery.notes: Chunk names and aliases are discovered by scripts/discover.py and rendered into host.mjs; chunk hashes are recorded in the install receipt, not pinned.
discovery.onFailure: Installation still proceeds (the overlay only adds its own files); the addon shows a dismissible note that it could not attach.
